verdict.rationale: This axis applies: Nix publishes extensive documentation at nix.dev and nixos.org, and that documentation could include an llms.txt file or agent-oriented docs. Probes found neither: https://nix.dev/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant both returned 404. Nothing else in the evidence describes agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
